purpose: Bounded pilot of first-pass hostile-review quality; not a model leaderboard.

artifact.claim: A new reminder layout reduces missed medication confirmations by at least 10% in one clinic.
artifact.scope: Adult patients using the clinic app during a four-week pilot.
evidence_for: A 12-person usability pilot showed fewer skipped confirmations.
evidence_against: The pilot had no control group.
artifact.falsification_condition: The preregistered controlled pilot shows less than a 10% relative reduction.
artifact.next_test: Randomize 80 eligible patients between the current and new layout.
artifact.exploration_cost: Two weeks and existing staff time.

benchmark.baseline: The current layout has a 21% missed-confirmation rate.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: Compared three reminder-layout studies; none tested this clinic workflow.
benchmark.result: The effect remains uncertain but is bounded and cheaply testable.

artifact.claim: The intervention improves learning outcomes for all secondary-school students.
assumptions: The measured subgroup represents the target population.
evidence_for: One post-hoc subgroup of 14 students improved.
evidence_against: The full 120-student sample showed no significant difference.
artifact.falsification_condition: A new study finds no population-wide improvement.
artifact.next_test: Repeat the intervention in another school.

benchmark.baseline: The preregistered primary outcome was null.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: Meta-analyses warn against post-hoc subgroup generalization.
benchmark.result: Only an unplanned small subgroup was positive.

artifact.claim: The framework succeeds whenever the analyst interprets the evidence with sufficient openness.
artifact.falsification_condition: No result can falsify it because a more open interpretation may reveal success.
artifact.next_test: Ask another analyst to use it.

benchmark.baseline: A useful framework must permit outcomes that count against it.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: Standard preregistration methods already constrain interpretive flexibility.
benchmark.result: The claim protects itself from every negative outcome.

artifact.claim: A novel Dual Copy Safety method prevents partial configuration writes by writing elsewhere before replacement.
artifact.scope: Single-process configuration files on POSIX systems.
assumptions: Rename is atomic on the target filesystem.
evidence_for: A prototype survived interruption before replacement.
artifact.falsification_condition: A crash leaves a partially written destination file.
artifact.next_test: Inject crashes at each write step.

benchmark.baseline: Write-temp, fsync and atomic rename is a standard established pattern.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: The proposed steps match the established atomic file replacement pattern.
benchmark.result: The mechanism is useful but the novelty claim is unsupported.

artifact.claim: The new code-review checklist caused the 30% reduction in production incidents.
artifact.scope: One engineering team over the last quarter.
assumptions: No other process change affected incidents.
evidence_against: Automated integration tests and a release freeze began in the same week.
artifact.falsification_condition: A comparable period using the checklist shows no reduction.
artifact.next_test: Compare incident categories before and after adoption.

benchmark.baseline: Before-after observations do not isolate simultaneous interventions.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: Interrupted time-series analysis can separate some concurrent effects.
benchmark.result: Three interventions coincide with the observed reduction.

artifact.claim: Material X changes phase through mechanism M rather than mechanism N under high pressure.
artifact.scope: Material X between 70 and 90 GPa at room temperature.
assumptions: The spectrometer calibration remains stable at high pressure.
evidence_against: The current resolution cannot distinguish M from N.
artifact.falsification_condition: A resolved diagnostic peak unique to N is observed.
artifact.next_test: Collect high-resolution spectra at a national synchrotron.
artifact.exploration_cost: Six months and a competitive facility allocation.

benchmark.baseline: M and N make distinct predictions only at higher spectral resolution.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: No published dataset reaches the required resolution for Material X.
benchmark.result: The claim is testable, but the decisive test is expensive.

artifact.claim: Users finish tasks faster because the animation guides attention to the primary action.
evidence_for: Interviewees described the animation as clear.
evidence_against: Instrumented tests show animated sessions are 18% slower and have equal error rates.

benchmark.baseline: The stated benefit is faster completion.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: No external solution is relevant to the direct within-product comparison.
benchmark.result: The direct measure contradicts the claimed direction of effect.

artifact.claim: A three-site replication can distinguish the intervention effect from a site-specific artifact.
artifact.scope: Three clinics using the same protocol.
evidence_for: The single-site pilot has a stable moderate effect.
evidence_against: No second site has replicated it.
artifact.falsification_condition: The pooled preregistered effect includes zero or is driven by one site.
artifact.exploration_cost: Twelve months; current funding covers only one site.

benchmark.baseline: Single-site effects often fail to generalize.
benchmark.existing_solution_search: No existing multisite replication was found.
benchmark.result: The hypothesis is testable; the current blocker is funding, not contradictory evidence.
